versions.description: v0.1.0: wt-osc abstraction + test harness + bake_geometry.py torus-SDF bank00
v0.2.0: terrain-osc abstraction + poly~ core + CPU test harness + test protocol
v0.3.0: terrain-osc rebuilt as single gen~ + buffer~ terrainbuf (feedback, mod inlets), matrix2buffer bridge, plan re-weighted after sonic review
v0.4.0: slice 3 -- terrain-voice (A terrain-osc / B wavetable, audio-rate terrain mod, svf~, adsr~) + terrain-synth main patch (MIDI, poly~ 8 up 2, p terrain-source, presentation UI); view deferred
v0.4.1: fix silent voices -- poly~ midinote delivers [pitch vel] as one list to in 1; voice now unpacks it (C74 adsr-synth form) instead of waiting for velocity on in 2
v0.4.2: terrain jit.pwindow back to 150x150 (MAX normalised the newobj form to 80x60 on re-save); window height fits MAX's 864x98 kslider
v0.5.0: jit.world terrain/orbit view (offscreen world -> texture -> jit.pwindow; tri_grid surface from the terrain matrix, helper terrain-osc + jit.catch~ orbit polyline, rotate/tilt)
v0.5.1: view render 512x512 (was 4:3 squeezed) + meshes scaled to fit, orbit as points, readout decimals (0 = auto in MAX -> 1), clipped view note, bank menu spacing
v0.5.2: view is a turntable -- meshes only yaw, jit.gl.camera on a 2.4 arc provides tilt (mesh rotatexyz x+y skewed the surface); mesh scale 0.6
v0.6.0: three new slot-B banks (noise soft / noise rough / torus noise) baked with new --field noise|blend options; bank menu with friendly names -> replace messages
v0.6.1: A>B MIX and POSITION had no effect (gen~ Param messages via the History-one de-hoist inside poly~) -> both now enter the voice gen~ as line~ signals (in3/in4)

v0.7.0: slot B is a second wave-terrain oscillator (terrain-osc-b: own terrain matrix/buffer, own orbit row + XY centre, B ratio + detune) replacing the wavetable bank; terrain mod drives both; view A/B switch; presentation re-flowed with a B row
